name: Iona Salt
caption: HARBOR SUPPLY OFFICE
greeting: The storm stripped the mooring lines. Can you spare some rope?
lore: We ring the bell twice when the tide turns. Three times means trouble.
objective: Bring three strings to Iona Salt to replace the harbor mooring lines.
accepted: Bring me three strings. I can braid a new line from those.
finished: That will hold. Check your quest book for the harbor pay.

responses.WAITING: I still need three strings before I can braid the line.
responses.LOCKED: Take the work order first so I can enter your name.
